cards.question: Scientists learn about early Indian tribes through ________ or objects from the past.
Most California Tribes had their own ways of speaking, acting, and dressing, also called:
Match the tribe with their main resources:

pairs.left: Tribes of the north coastal region

cards.question: When did the early people first reach California?
Scientist think that the first people to come to California did it by using:
choices: A land bridge during the ice age.
cards.answer: A land bridge during the ice age.

cards.question: Games were important for the Miwok and other tribes because they taught the children:
What does specialize mean?
choices: To work together for the good of the group.
To work at one kind of job and learn to do it well.
To sell and buy resources from other tribes.
cards.answer: To work at one kind of job and learn to do it well.

cards.question: Why was storytelling a big part of the lives of California Indian tribes?
cards.answer: By telling stories they passed down their traditions, and culture and trained youth how to do the necessary work.

cards.question: What role did trade play in the lives of California tribes?
cards.answer: Trading was a way to obtain the resources that they did not have where they lived.

cards.question: How did early people in North America adapt their way of life when large animals died out?
cards.answer: They started hunting smaller animals, gathering berries and nuts, fishing, some tribes learned to 'farm.'
